author: Ben Blanchet
title: Seth Meyers Awards Trump With 1 Well-Deserved Honor Over This Kennedy Center Tale - NewsBreak
text: Seth Meyers tore apart Donald Trump on Wednesday after the president announced his plans to host this year’s Kennedy Center Honors ceremony amid his power grab of the Washington, D.C., arts institution. The “ Late Night ” host turned to a clip of the center’s new chairman — Trump — claiming that he initially dismissed the gig. ″‘Are you fools asking me to do that?’ ‘Sir, you’ll get much higher ratings.’ I said, ‘I don’t care. I’m president of the United States. I won’t do it,’” recalled Trump at a rambling press conference where he announced the center’s 2025 honorees. He continued, “They said, ‘Please.’ And then [Kennedy Center board member and White House Chief of Staff] Susie Wiles said to me, ‘Sir, I’d like you to host.’ I said, ‘OK, Susie, I’ll do it.’” Meyers swiftly gave his two cents on the tale. “Well, I think you deserve the award for Best Original Screenplay because that’s definitely a fake conversation that did not happen,” quipped Meyers before launching into his Trump impression. “They said, ‘Sir, we want you to host.’ And I said, ‘You’re fools! I’m so busy!’ And they said, ‘The ratings would be huge because everyone loves you.’ And I said, ‘That’s true.’ And then I said, ‘What will I wear?’ And they said, ‘Don’t worry, we’ll make a special tuxedo that’s big enough for your incredibly large penis.’” Moments earlier, Meyers argued that Trump was “definitely not joking” when he used the presser to suggest that he’d honor himself at next year’s ceremony. He made a nod to fake Time magazine covers of Trump that were hanging up at his golf resorts and the president’s repeated claims that he won a Michigan “Man of the Year” award despite never living in the state, which also does not give out such an award. “I have no trouble believing that he gives himself a made-up award called, ‘The Kennedy Center Lifetime Achievement Nobel Prize EGOT Award For Most Everything’ and the award will just be a little golden statue of himself getting an award,” Meyers joked.
